    The residual shift on the strict deck-orbit skeleton #

    For N ◁ G, the residual G / N-shift on the nonskeletal N-shift-orbit category transports to the chosen deck-orbit skeleton. Its degree-q functor is literally the fixed strict translation by the chosen representative Quotient.out q; the coherence is transported through the fully faithful representative functor.
